about.body: Reads FAT, exFAT, NTFS, ext2/3/4, btrfs, F2FS and XFS, and finds more than 40 file types by signature.
browse.none_body: Loosen the filters or try a deeper scan.
browse.scanning_body: Files will appear here as they are found.
col.name: Name
drives.title: Drives
fact.net_sub: Nothing leaves your computer. Update checks run only when you ask.
fact.ro_sub: The engine has no code path that writes to the source.
fact.root_sub: The engine drops its privileges right after opening the disk.
filter.title: Filters
grep.body: Searches inside documents and text files up to 32 MB.
grep.label: Text to find
health.fail_body: Make a disk image first and scan the image.
health.none: This device does not report SMART data.
health.title: Disk health
hero.sub: Deep-scan any drive, preview what turns up and recover it. The source is never written to.
hero.title: Bring back what you deleted
hint.good_tip: This kind of device keeps deleted data until it is overwritten.
hint.ssd_tip: Deleted data is gone once TRIM runs on an SSD. Act quickly.
hint.trim_tip: This SSD erases deleted data quickly. Snapshots and very recent files can still be found.
hist.empty_body: Finished scans are kept here so you can return without scanning again.
home.plug: Plug in a USB drive or memory card and it appears here instantly.
image.body: {d} ({s}) is copied to a file sector by sector. On a failing disk, image first and scan the image.
image.paused: Stopped. Start again to continue where it left off.
image.title: Create disk image
mode.deep_body: Quick scan plus a signature search of free space.
mode.full_body: Searches the whole disk. Best for formatted disks.
mode.quick_body: Reads file system records. Keeps names and folders.
note.corrupt: Could not be opened; the file looks damaged
note.csum_bad: Data has changed: checksum does not match
note.efs: Encrypted with EFS; unreadable without the key
note.meta_bad: File system is damaged; using signature search
note.mft_bad: File table is damaged; records were found by sweeping
note.mostly_zero: Most of this file has been erased
note.no_journal: No journal; names and locations are limited
note.part_zero: Part of this file has been erased; partly recoverable
note.sig_mismatch: Content does not look like .{a}; it may be overwritten
note.truncated: End of file could not be confirmed; it may be cut off
note.zeroed: Data has been erased (TRIM or overwrite)
notif.title: Scan finished
part.locked: Encrypted and locked. Click to unlock.
pick.title: What do you want to scan?
prev.too_big: Too large to preview; recover it first.
prev.zero_body: The data may have been erased by TRIM or overwritten.
prot.ro_on: Salvage never writes to the source
prot.snap_off: Not set up, so deletions can't be rolled back
prot.trim_on: On: deleted data can vanish quickly
rec.accept: I understand the risk, recover here anyway
rec.no_room: Not enough space at the destination
rec.same_body: Recovered files may overwrite data not yet read. Another disk or USB drive is safest.
rec.same_disk: Destination is on the same disk
rec.same_disk_body: It is a different partition so it is safe, but a separate disk is better.
rec.skip_sub: Files marked Lost are not written.
rec.title: Recover files
rec.tree_sub: When off, files are sorted by type.
rec.verify_sub: Each written file is read back and compared.
session.auth_body: Enter your password in the window that opened.
session.rescued_body: They are in memory and disappear on restart. Move them to another disk.
session.trim_held: TRIM is paused during this scan
session.zeroed: About {p}% of free space is erased
session.zeroed_body: The SSD may have cleared deleted data with TRIM. Files marked Lost cannot return.
set.nopass: Do not ask for a password
set.nopass_sub: Any program running as you could then read whole disks. Turn on only on a computer you trust.
set.notify_sub: Shows a desktop notification when a scan ends.
set.save_sub: Reopen them from History without scanning again.
set.wall_sub: Updates live when the wallpaper changes.
setup.background_sub: Gives way to other disk activity.
setup.existing_sub: Useful for copying intact files from a damaged disk.
setup.hold_trim_sub: Stops the SSD from erasing deleted data; restored automatically afterwards.
setup.lost_sub: Finds partitions missing from the partition table.
setup.mounted_body: While mounted, the system may write to it. Unmount it so deleted data is not overwritten.
setup.repair_sub: Tries to join JPEGs split into two pieces.
setup.rescue_sub: Copies the best candidates to memory as soon as they are found.
setup.system_body: Deleted space is overwritten as the system runs. Save recovered files to another disk.
setup.system_trim: TRIM is on: deleted data disappeared in about a minute in our tests. Recover what you find right away, to another disk.
setup.title: Scan
sort.name: By name
sum.hint: Click a file to preview it.
sum.title: Scan summary
tip.body: Stop using a drive as soon as you notice a loss. Every new write can overwrite deleted data.
unlock.title: Unlock encrypted disk
update.none_yet: No release has been published yet.
